brief:
Tony Blair, acting as an envoy for Donald Trump's Board of Peace, recently asked the Palestinian Authority to replace mentions of "Palestine" in educational textbooks, according to a former UK envoy who spoke with Middle East Eye. The request represents an unusual intervention into Palestinian curriculum policy. Blair's specific demands and the reasoning behind them remain unclear from available accounts.

The initiative comes amid broader diplomatic efforts tied to Trump's peace proposal for the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Educational materials have long been a contested element in peace negotiations, with previous peace efforts also targeting school curricula. The extent to which the Palestinian Authority has responded to Blair's request has not been disclosed.

title: Blair pressed Palestinian Authority to remove 'Palestine' from school textbooks
